target.name: ground_truth_label
target.independence_rule: Assigned by the scenario ground-truth generator before feature extraction; never derived from features, rules, risk, alerts, investigations, or predictions.

temporal_contract.rule: For event e at (event_timestamp, event_sequence), a feature may use e and records with an earlier lexicographic (event_timestamp, event_sequence) only.
temporal_contract.equal_timestamp_order: The future raw dataset must assign a unique, deterministic event_sequence at generation time. Equal timestamps are ordered by event_sequence; no feature may use a later sequence.

cold_start_policy: Counts and sums use 0; ratios, shares, entropy, concentration, dispersion, acceleration and z-scores use 0 as the documented neutral/no-evidence value; new-relationship flags use 0 until at least one eligible historical event exists. Missing or NULL agent_id produces 0 for every agent-context feature.

features.name: structuring_prior_tx_count_1h
features.definition: Prior outgoing transactions by the sender in the preceding hour.
features.aml_rationale: Measures short-burst fragmentation.

features.name: structuring_prior_value_sum_24h
features.definition: Prior outgoing transaction value accumulated by the sender in the preceding 24 hours.
features.leakage_risk: Low; excludes current and future events.
features.aml_rationale: Measures cumulative value moved through repeated activity.

features.name: structuring_same_day_prior_tx_count
features.definition: Prior outgoing transaction count by sender on the current calendar day.
features.window: Start of event day to t
features.aml_rationale: Captures same-day transaction splitting.

features.name: structuring_repeated_amount_ratio_7d
features.definition: Share of prior sender transactions in seven days whose amount is within 5% of the current amount.
features.leakage_risk: Low; uses current value and prior values, not labels or rules.
features.aml_rationale: Detects repeated, similarly sized fragments without encoding a fixed regulatory rule band.

features.name: structuring_amount_cluster_dispersion_7d
features.definition: Relative dispersion of prior sender amounts in seven days.
features.aml_rationale: Low dispersion complements repeated-amount evidence by representing clustered fragment sizes.

features.name: structuring_near_threshold_history_ratio_7d
features.definition: Share of prior sender amounts in seven days within 10% below the configured mobile-money reporting threshold.
features.leakage_risk: Medium: threshold-concept feature; it must not reuse rule output or determine y.
features.aml_rationale: Measures behavioural concentration near a reporting boundary rather than a rule hit.

features.name: network_outbound_counterparty_count_7d
features.definition: Distinct receivers paid by the sender in seven days.
features.aml_rationale: Measures relationship diversity and expansion.

features.name: network_inbound_counterparty_count_7d
features.definition: Distinct wallets that previously paid the sender in seven days.
features.aml_rationale: Captures inbound network breadth relevant to collection/funnelling behaviour.

features.name: network_outbound_counterparty_entropy_30d
features.definition: Entropy of sender's prior outbound receiver distribution.
features.aml_rationale: Distinguishes concentrated from dispersed payment relationships.

features.name: network_top_counterparty_value_share_30d
features.definition: Largest receiver's share of sender's prior outbound value.
features.aml_rationale: Measures dominant relationship concentration.

features.name: network_current_receiver_is_new
features.definition: Whether the current receiver has not appeared in sender's earlier outbound history.
features.cold_start: 0 until one prior outbound event exists
features.aml_rationale: Identifies abrupt relationship creation without using an identity as an input.

features.name: network_repeated_receiver_ratio_30d
features.definition: Share of prior outbound transactions to receivers seen at least twice in the prior 30-day history.
features.formula: count(tx to receiver with prior frequency≥2) / count(H_sender_out_30d)
features.aml_rationale: Complements diversity with relationship persistence.

features.name: network_reciprocal_flow_ratio_7d
features.definition: Share of sender's active counterparties with both inbound and outbound transfers during the window.
features.formula: count(counterparties with both directions) / count(active counterparties)
features.aml_rationale: Represents circular or reciprocal wallet relationships.

features.name: network_counterparty_set_change_7d
features.definition: Change between the most recent and preceding seven-day outbound receiver sets.
features.aml_rationale: Measures network expansion or abrupt relationship turnover.

features.name: network_pass_through_ratio_24h
features.definition: Prior outbound value divided by prior inbound value for the sender.
features.formula: sum(outbound amount H_24h) / max(sum(inbound amount H_24h),1)
features.aml_rationale: Measures rapid onward movement through wallet relationships.

features.name: network_shared_counterparty_concentration_7d
features.definition: Maximum share of the sender's current counterparties that also interacted with any of the sender's other counterparties in the prior window.
features.formula: max over counterparties c of shared-neighbour_count(c) / max(active_counterparty_count,1)
features.leakage_risk: Low; graph is built only from earlier edges.
features.aml_rationale: Provides feasible second-order network concentration without using wallet IDs as features.

features.name: agent_prior_tx_count_1h
features.definition: Transactions attributable to the current agent in the preceding hour.
features.leakage_risk: Low; agent_id is grouping key only, never X.
features.aml_rationale: Measures short-period agent activity bursts.

features.name: agent_prior_tx_count_7d
features.definition: Transactions attributable to the current agent in seven days.
features.aml_rationale: Measures sustained agent throughput.

features.name: agent_prior_value_sum_1h
features.definition: Value handled by current agent in the preceding hour.
features.aml_rationale: Captures high-value burst behaviour.

features.name: agent_prior_value_sum_7d
features.definition: Value handled by current agent in seven days.
features.aml_rationale: Measures sustained value concentration.

features.name: agent_unique_wallet_count_7d
features.definition: Distinct wallets associated with prior transactions at the current agent.
features.aml_rationale: Measures breadth of the agent's customer footprint.

features.name: agent_wallet_value_hhi_7d
features.definition: Herfindahl-Hirschman concentration of prior agent-handled value by wallet.
features.aml_rationale: Identifies disproportionate dependence on a small wallet set.

features.name: agent_repeat_wallet_ratio_7d
features.definition: Share of prior agent transactions involving wallets seen at the agent at least twice in the window.
features.formula: count(tx involving wallet with agent frequency≥2) / count(H_agent_7d)
features.aml_rationale: Measures repeated wallet-agent relationships.

features.name: agent_current_wallet_is_new
features.definition: Whether the current transaction's initiating wallet is unseen in the agent's earlier history.
features.cold_start: 0 until prior agent history exists; 0 when agent_id is NULL
features.aml_rationale: Detects abrupt wallet-agent relationship expansion.

features.name: agent_inbound_outbound_value_ratio_7d
features.definition: Prior agent-attributable outbound value divided by inbound value.
features.aml_rationale: Captures flow imbalance through an agent.

features.name: agent_high_value_event_share_7d
features.definition: Share of prior agent transactions whose amount exceeds twice that agent's preceding-30-day median amount.
features.cold_start: 0 until 30-day baseline has 3 events; 0 when agent_id is NULL
features.leakage_risk: Low; uses only pre-event baseline, no fixed AML threshold.
features.aml_rationale: Measures unusual value handling relative to agent history.

features.name: agent_hourly_tx_zscore_30d
features.definition: Deviation of prior completed hourly transaction count from the agent's prior completed-hour baseline.
features.window: Current completed hour and prior 30 days
features.cold_start: 0 until 7 completed prior hours; 0 when agent_id is NULL
features.aml_rationale: Detects abnormal agent activity intensity.

features.name: agent_hourly_value_zscore_30d
features.definition: Deviation of prior completed hourly handled value from the agent's prior completed-hour value baseline.
features.window: Current completed hour and prior 30 days
features.cold_start: 0 until 7 completed prior hours; 0 when agent_id is NULL
features.aml_rationale: Detects abnormal value handling relative to own baseline.

features.name: agent_burst_concentration_7d
features.definition: Largest prior 15-minute event bucket share of all prior agent events.
features.aml_rationale: Captures unusually concentrated temporal agent activity.

features.name: agent_shared_wallet_flow_concentration_7d
features.definition: Maximum share of agent-associated wallets that previously sent to or received from the same external counterparty.
features.formula: max_counterparty(distinct associated wallets linked to counterparty) / max(distinct associated wallets,1)
features.leakage_risk: Low; uses earlier agent-linked relationship edges only.
features.aml_rationale: Measures coordinated multi-wallet flow concentration around an agent.
